scope: Paired authored PiPER reliability pilot, privileged native state and synthetic rigid blocks. No learned policy, sensor pipeline, calibrated contact, shoe competence or physical robot qualification.

contract.scope: Authored PiPER rigid-block contact pilot with privileged native state. Pinned upstream servos/inertias/collision proxies/gravity compensation, synthetic commands and uncalibrated contact. No learned skill, camera sensing, shoe manipulation or physical robot qualification.

actions.joint_targets_rad: six native position-servo targets in radians
actions.gripper_position_m: one native single-finger slide target in metres [0,.035]; 0 closed/.035 open; not measured full gap

contract.tcp: authored site in link6 at local [0,0,.12003] near the distal finger-box centers; not hardware calibrated
contract.object: free rigid block with native gravity, no weld/equality/mocap or post-reset pose writes
contract.contact: stock native finger collision boxes; object priority1 authors pair friction explicitly
contract.servo_gains: unchanged upstream PiPER position servos and force caps; upstream robot gravcomp=1 retained
contract.collision_support_exemption: fixed base capsule may contact floor; moving robot/table/floor or block/nonfinger contacts are critical
contract.observations: privileged joint/object/TCP/contact state; no deployable sensor pipeline
contract.success: valid native physics, sustained bilateral table-free lift and retained carry to supported destination, then actual released/settled destination dwell and retreat

acquisition.observations: grip check uses causal current privileged TCP/object pose and bilateral native contacts at 20 ms; no mass/friction or scorer input; downstream original motion policy remains unchanged and uses the existing lift outcome flag
acquisition.qualification: slow 10 mm probe; object rises at least 6 mm, both pads retain contact, support is absent and TCP-local drift <=3 mm for 100 ms
acquisition.alarm: two consecutive snapshots with relative drift, bilateral-contact loss or supported object failing to follow a moving probe; bounded closure/probe timeouts
acquisition.recovery: hold measured six joint targets first; only supported objects may be opened/recentered/retried, at most once; support loss stops closed
acquisition.stop: requested measured joint targets; native rate limiting and inertia may continue motion, which is recorded
acquisition.duration: original fixed episode timeout including every probe/retry/abort holding command

contact_contract.history: inclusive past 120 ms of TCP-local object offset; unknown before 100 ms span; displacement is endpoint Euclidean distance, rate is displacement/span, slope is least-squares vector rate, straightness is displacement/summed consecutive path
contact_contract.trend: rate >=25 mm/s, displacement >=2.5 mm and straightness >=0.7 for two snapshots; two bilateral-contact-loss snapshots independently request closed hold

contact_contract.probe_only: identical acquisition and retry; removes postqualification carry monitoring only
contact_contract.stop: measured joint-position requests with jaw closed; inertia and native target rate limits may continue physical motion
contact_contract.duration: unchanged fixed episode budget including probe, retry, slowdown, hold and abort; no force/gain/dynamics/scorer change

following.scope: Independent recorded 20ms boundary proxies, not recomputed native physics or classifier accuracy. Following requires table-free object rise and stable TCP-local object offset, without controller predicates. Unresolved decisions and absent opportunities remain explicit. Alarm delays use simulator timestamps; wall computation is reported separately. Post-alarm path includes native servo motion while holding.

contact.scope: Independent recorded 20ms boundaries, not detector accuracy or physics recomputation. Motion windows retain actual native movement after commands, not instantaneous arrest. Settled, resumed and completed are separate; no observed true-slip opportunity is not a perfect score.

evaluation_contract.comparison: Completion and valid denominator first; completion time deltas only in paired common successes. Unsuccessful acquisitions retain bounded terminal decisions and the full original 20-second episode. Recovery duration includes unresolved holds; sampled motion is not a physical speed guarantee.
evaluation_contract.scope: Recorded 20ms boundaries, not true-slip labels, independent physical truth or real-time sensor latency.

timing_boundary: Attempt wall includes asset verification, compilation, settling, authored planning/IK, physics, contact scoring and recorded state construction. Protocol/report/trace disk serialization, rendering, training, physical sensing, transport and actuation are excluded. Control computation windows are not sensor-to-actuator reaction times.
comparison: Identical native mechanics, initial state and full twenty-second duration per scene. Frozen v0.4 recovery versus bounded second lift and optional fixed alternate-grasp plus second lift. Each placement has its own complete arm-tape/open-jaw control, plus a shared initial-arm hold. The second-lift ablation separates carry recovery from alternate-grasp planning. Every attempted failure, invalid result and unresolved recovery remains in the denominator.
split_note: Synthetic declared confirmation does not prove unseen scenes or physical reliability. Controller/evaluation parameters and sources are frozen before any native attempt.

grasp_strategy.candidate: fixed world-z yaw of the downward grasp orientation; original approach orientation; optionally retain that yaw through postapproach carry poses
grasp_strategy.planner: bounded differential IK; translation error <=15 mm, orientation error <= configured limit only when requested quaternion matches the downward grasp target (absolute quaternion dot >=1-1e-12), original 0.05 rad for all other targets; joint delta <=0.06 rad, damping 0.012, original position/jaw target rates and native control limits
grasp_strategy.unchanged: native gains, force limits, geometry, friction, integration, task scoring and 20-second budget
grasp_strategy.scope: authored fixed development candidate, privileged native state, no material/mass/friction/outcome-based grasp selection and no hardware validation

reacquire_grasp.selection: fixed before the episode; no hidden mass, friction, outcome, or future observation inputs
reacquire_grasp.scope: experimental authored simulator candidate; alternate grasp acquisition alone is not completed placement

policy_inputs_contract.native_lift_seen: Boolean native 1ms lift latch recorded at each 20ms state, including terminal; monotonic and corroborated by sampled lift evidence. The original teacher reads this recorded flag during policy audit.
policy_inputs_contract.audit: Portable checks validate stored native/task/pair evidence and explicit second-probe prerequisites/bounds. With pinned assets, replay the frozen authored policy and reconstruct IK at recorded states. No native trajectory reintegration or authenticity claim.
